subject: MAP: Engage-to-Commit checklist & billing wiring for Evergreen Analytics
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Engage-to-Commit checklist & billing wiring for Evergreen Analytics

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for a productive demo last week. Attached is our proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to move Evergreen from evaluation to purchase via a private offer on AWS/GCP. This is a pragmatic, date-driven checklist — keeps legal, procurement, finance, and infra aligned. Highlights:

- Week 1 (Jun 20–26): Legal redline + procurement PO template + billing wiring info
- Week 2 (Jun 27–Jul 3): Final SOW and DocuSign circulation; payment terms confirmed
- Week 3 (Jul 4–Jul 10): Private offer activation in marketplace; test invoice issuance + early onboarding

Attachments: 20280620-Redwood-MAP-Evergreen-v1.pdf (MAP draft), Redwood-Standard-SOW-2028.docx (SOW template).

Ask: please confirm your procurement contact and the preferred billing cadence (Net 30 vs Net 45). If you need our procurement checklist in a different format (spreadsheet), I can send it.

I'll loop Aditya for pricing exceptions and Hiro for any billing wiring specifics (ACH vs wire).

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: 20280620-Redwood-MAP-Evergreen-v1.pdf (MAP draft; 3 pages)]

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@evergreen.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@evergreen.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Engage-to-Commit checklist & billing wiring for Evergreen Analytics

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear plan and the MAP doc — very helpful. Quick questions from procurement and finance after an initial pass:

1) Our procurement needs to see an itemized invoice schedule tied to milestones (PO -> activation -> onboarding invoice). Can you provide a one-page invoice milestone table?
2) We prefer ACH where possible; can Redwood accept ACH for the initial term? If not, we'll need wire instructions and routing numbers.
3) Legal had a few quick asks: a) Can Redwood confirm data locality commitments for the private offer (region-specific deployment)? b) Is there an SLA credit template you use for marketplace offers?

Cc'd our finance lead to get a sense of timing for sign-off.

Thanks —
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement, Evergreen Analytics
marta.lopez@evergreen.ai

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 11:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP: Engage-to-Commit checklist & billing wiring for Evergreen Analytics

Marta —

Thanks for the quick review. Answers inline below and a short attachment (one-page invoice milestone table) is included.

1) Invoice milestone table: attached as page 1 of the MAP PDF and again as a one-page table in the new attachment. Milestones:
   - PO issuance: 100% deposit on signature (optional to split 50/50 if required)
   - Activation (private offer published): 30% of term invoice to confirm provisioning
   - Onboarding completion (first seat/month): remainder invoiced monthly thereafter

2) ACH: Redwood can accept ACH for US customers. I'll have Hiro share bank details and an ACH-friendly routing stub; we can also provide wire instructions if procurement requires it.

3a) Data locality: yes — private offer deployments can be pinned by region (we support us-east-1, us-west-2, europe-west1). We'll add the commitment language to the SOW.
3b) SLA credit language: we have a marketplace SLA credit template. I'll attach the short SLA paragraph and can include it in the DocuSign SOW.

Attachments now: 20280622-Evergreen-invoice-milestones.pdf, Redwood-SLA-credit-template.txt (small).

Next steps suggested:
- Marta/procurement: confirm ACH vs wire and provide the PO contact details by Jun 24
- Redwood (Aditya): issue a final SOW with merged legal edits by Jun 28
- Redwood (Hiro): send bank/ACH stub and DocuSign envelope to circulate

Thanks —
Hannah

Hi Marta —

Following Hannah's thread and attached docs, here's the operational plan from Redwood to close the PO and get Evergreen live with a private offer on AWS/GCP.

Quick summary/actionable items for procurement/finance:
- DocuSign: final SOW + order form sent (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/abc12345). Please sign the order form to generate the PO number on your side.
- Billing path: ACH accepted (US); wire instructions attached. If you want Redwood to raise an invoice tied to your PO number, include PO in the DocuSign order form field.
- Marketplace private offer activation: once signed and payment method confirmed, we create the private offer in the marketplace and assign SKU. Expect activation within 48 business hours after payment details verified.
- Invoice cadence: first invoice published at activation; recurring invoices monthly thereafter according to the selected cadence (Net 30 default).

Attachments (stubs): Redwood-Wire-Instructions.pdf, Final-SOW-Evergreen-2028.pdf.

HubSpot deal id: HS-2028-1374 (I've updated stage to "Commit — PO Received" pending DocuSign).

If procurement needs a single-thread contact: please use finance@redwood.com (billing triage). For technical onboarding scheduling, Hiro will take point.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Americas, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0167
